`tone.mp3` is a generated synthetic C4 sine plus 120 BPM low-frequency pulses,
8 seconds, stereo 44.1 kHz. The first pulse starts at 120 ms. It was encoded
with FFmpeg/libmp3lame at 320 kbps solely to test this program. It contains no
commercial music or personal data. Copyright 2026 StickMix contributors,
GPL-3.0-or-later, like the tests that use it.
